# SEODXB

> A global SEO agency based in Dubai, specialising in On-Page SEO, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO). We help businesses worldwide get found on Google, cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and every AI-powered search surface.

## What We Do

SEODXB solves the biggest problem most websites face: a lack of organic traffic. We prepare brands for three layers of modern search:

- **On-Page SEO** — Technical audits, keyword strategy, content optimisation, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, and internal linking
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)** — Targeting featured snippets, People Also Ask, and voice search to achieve Position Zero
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)** — Ensuring your brand is cited, recommended, and surfaced by AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude

Based in Dubai, UAE. Serving clients globally — UAE, UK, US, Europe, and beyond.
